expected.description: Extract the ordered query path pipeline.answer_question -> planner.plan_query -> retrieval.hybrid_retrieve -> agentic.run_bounded_loop -> provenance.verify_claims.
Identify planning/retrieval/agentic/provenance as separate stages and state that the benchmark has no external LLM API runtime dependency.
Do not modify source files; only benchmark_output/task_01_result.json may be created.
A valid entity record is returned with canonical id and bounded confidence.
Missing required evidence fields are rejected.
Unknown entity and relation types are rejected rather than coerced.
Confidence outside [0,1] is rejected.
All 5 Task 02 tests pass.
Organization-develops-Technology is valid.
Relation alias builds is repairable to develops.
Invalid domain and range are rejected with explicit reasons.
Unknown class/relation are rejected.
All 6 Task 03 tests pass.
OpenAI resolves exactly to org:openai.
MSFT resolves as an alias to org:microsoft.
Atlas is ambiguous between org:atlas and tech:atlas and has no selected id.
NeoSemanticX remains unresolved with no fabricated id.
All 5 Task 04 tests pass.
Vector and graph raw scores are independently normalized before fusion.
Shared evidence e2 is deduplicated and ranked first with equal weights.
Each result exposes normalized vector score, normalized graph score, and fused score.
Vector-only and graph-only fallbacks are deterministic.
All 5 Task 05 tests pass.
Definition query routes to local_semantic.
Direct relationship query routes to local_graph.
Corpus-wide theme query routes to global_community.
Compositional relation query routes to multi_hop.
Plans are deterministic, structured, and max_steps is between 1 and 4.
All Task 06 tests pass.
Sufficient evidence stops after one retrieval.
Insufficient evidence may reformulate once and stop when sufficient.
Contradictory evidence may trigger a bounded reformulation.
A repeated query terminates with repeated_query instead of looping.
Hard max_steps prevents more than 3 retrievals in the fixture.
All 5 Task 07 tests pass.
c1 is supported and includes evidence e1 plus graph path provenance.
c2 is partially_supported.
c3 is contradicted.
c4 is unsupported and has no evidence ids.
All 4 Task 08 tests pass.
Input ontology remains unchanged after proposal generation.
Organization/uses are existing; Org/utilizes map through aliases.
ResearchMethod is a reviewable new_candidate with confidence and examples.
Graph is preserved as a conflict with an explicit reason.
apply_automatically is false.
All 5 Task 09 tests pass.
retrieval_recall = 0.75.
graph_path_validity = 2/3, excluding None.
ontology_violation_rate = 0.25.
provenance_coverage = 0.75.
mean_latency_ms = 150 and total_tokens = 1000.
failure_breakdown = {success:2,retrieval:1,reasoning:1}.
All 6 Task 10 tests pass.
